item.title: Roadmap
item.description:
Nothing on this page has shipped. It is the list of what the engine will not do on day one, so nobody has to guess.

In progress

Item Status
Engine M1: native, wazero executor; wctr pull, run, ps, logs, rm, rmi, inspect, images in progress

Planned

Item What it is
Browser executor the executor contract in a browser Web Worker, which the playground needs
Playground an in-browser terminal running wctr against WASI containers, for cloud and container training labs (the playground repository exists; no code yet)
Networking containers that listen and connect, through the WasmEdge socket ABI
Classroom relay students’ browsers reach each other’s containers through a relay on the teacher’s laptop that is also a firewall with security groups modelled on OpenStack Neutron, managed through a gRPC control API and the wctr-relay command; see the design (milestones M-relay-1 to M-relay-5)
Shell and exec wctr exec and an interactive shell, through a WASIX subset
Image build building an image from a Dockerfile
Compose several containers described in one file
Mini-Kubernetes enough of the orchestrator’s API to teach its concepts
apt-like images a base image plus tools, from pkgx wasip1 bottles, once go-pkgx has its wasip1/wasm target

An item moves to “in progress” when its code is on a branch, and is removed from this page when it ships, with the release that carries it.
